method: Quality agent checks separately curated source-anchored facts frozen before model calls; no independent external human rating or full precision metric.

samples.observation: Points 2/3/4 split the preparation/class-task principle and its weekly schedule/English fallback supporting details. The supporting facts are distinct, so these are not scored as pure semantic duplicates. 45/5 timing and the tail question options are retained.

Assessment reasons, feedback contents, private delivery and cultural illustration have distinct supporting facts. No fixed scores, current Engrade endorsement or universal claim about all people detected.

The final 306-character point packs object types, conversion, arithmetic, assignment/rebinding, print and shell/editor usage into one catch-all. The final area-not-recomputed conclusion exists in section 2 and final merge; no routing/merge omission of an essential fact measured. Different consequences of explicit instruction are not counted as repetition.

single_fix_hypothesis: Explicit main-topic grouping can combine a principle with its supporting reasons/conditions/examples, and prioritize core content without a catch-all point, while retaining important facts and conditions. Measure on unchanged sources/facts/model/configuration; no semantic deletion heuristic or hard length cap.
engineering_rules: Skills outrank plans; UI skills and three-layer tokens; configurable abilities; stable narrow service interfaces; yt-dlp only through ytdlp_service.py; visuals read-only.
